headline: Anthropic Posts Job for Energy Specialist to Power AI Data Centers
summary: AI startup Anthropic posted a $405,000 role for a natural gas specialist to secure power supplies for data centers as its public shares traded below their IPO price.
why: High energy consumption in AI workload processing has turned power availability into a fundamental cost and expansion driver for artificial intelligence developers.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Capital expenditure on power infrastructure and post-IPO share price declines affect valuation multiples.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
